title: Fast chess rules for Go
description: Bitboard chess rules for Go. Learn chess-on-go with runnable examples, API guides, and reproducible performance comparisons.

title: Getting started
description: Install chess-on-go, play your first moves, and choose the right API for your Go application.

title: Moves & game state
description: Validate UCI and SAN moves, handle promotion, inspect status, undo moves, and clone positions.

title: FEN, PGN & persistence
description: Load and export positions, replay PGN, parse EPD suites, and persist game state.

title: Variants
description: Use Chess960, King of the Hill, and Three-check through explicit variant APIs.

title: Search & perft
description: Traverse legal move trees with reusable buffers and fast make/unmake operations.

title: API reference
description: A practical map of constructors, moves, board accessors, notation, errors, and analysis APIs.

title: Runnable examples
description: Copy complete Go programs for game play, serialization, variants, search, and a chess HTTP endpoint.

title: Performance
description: Measured comparison with corentings/chess v2.6.1, allocations, workload definitions, raw samples, and reproduction commands.
